mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.actual_qty), 0) FROM mis_stock_out o JOIN mis_stock_out_detail d ON o.id = d.stock_out_id WHERE o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time <= #{end} AND o.approve_status = '1' AND o.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0'

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) as date, 0 as inQty, COALESCE(SUM(d.actual_qty), 0) as outQty FROM mis_stock_out o JOIN mis_stock_out_detail d ON o.id = d.stock_out_id WHERE o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time <= #{end} AND o.approve_status = '1' AND o.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY date
